arguments.sql:
SELECT ra.name, ra.date, ra.time AS recorded_start,
       c.name AS circuit, c.location, c.country,
       d.forename, d.surname, d.url, re.time AS race_duration,
       re.milliseconds, typeof(re.milliseconds) AS duration_type,
       (SELECT MIN(p.time) FROM main.pitStops AS p WHERE p.raceId = ra.raceId) AS first_recorded_pit_stop
FROM main.races AS ra
JOIN main.circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = ra.circuitId
JOIN main.results AS re ON re.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN main.drivers AS d ON d.driverId = re.driverId
WHERE ra.year = 2017 AND ra.name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix' AND re.position = 1;

arguments.sql:
WITH lap_clock AS (
    SELECT l.raceId, l.driverId, l.lap,
           SUM(l.milliseconds) OVER (
               PARTITION BY l.raceId, l.driverId ORDER BY l.lap
           ) / 1000.0 AS seconds_through_lap
    FROM main.lapTimes AS l
    JOIN main.races AS r ON r.raceId = l.raceId
    WHERE r.year = 2017 AND r.name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix'
)
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, p.lap, p.time AS pit_clock,
       ROUND(l.seconds_through_lap, 3) AS seconds_through_lap,
       ROUND(CAST(strftime('%s', p.time) AS INTEGER)
         - CAST(strftime('%s', r.time) AS INTEGER)
         - l.seconds_through_lap, 3) AS clock_difference_seconds
FROM main.races AS r
JOIN main.pitStops AS p ON p.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN lap_clock AS l ON l.raceId = p.raceId AND l.driverId = p.driverId AND l.lap = p.lap
JOIN main.drivers AS d ON d.driverId = p.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017 AND r.name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix'
ORDER BY p.time, p.driverId
LIMIT 12;

arguments.sql:
WITH race AS (
    SELECT raceId, time
    FROM main.races
    WHERE year = 2017 AND name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix'
),
laps AS (
    SELECT l.raceId, l.driverId, l.lap, l.milliseconds,
           SUM(l.milliseconds) OVER (
               PARTITION BY l.raceId, l.driverId ORDER BY l.lap
           ) AS elapsed_ms
    FROM main.lapTimes AS l
    JOIN race ON race.raceId = l.raceId
),
pit_anchors AS (
    SELECT p.time,
           CAST(strftime('%s', p.time) AS INTEGER) * 1000 - l.elapsed_ms AS implied_start_ms
    FROM main.pitStops AS p
    JOIN laps AS l ON l.raceId = p.raceId AND l.driverId = p.driverId AND l.lap = p.lap
)
SELECT re.milliseconds AS winner_elapsed_ms,
       l.elapsed_ms AS winner_total_lap_ms,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pit_anchors) AS pit_stop_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pit_anchors WHERE instr(time, '.') <> 0) AS pit_stops_with_fractional_seconds,
       (SELECT strftime('%H:%M:%f', MIN(implied_start_ms) / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') FROM pit_anchors) AS earliest_implied_start,
       (SELECT strftime('%H:%M:%f', MAX(implied_start_ms) / 1000.0, 'unixepoch') FROM pit_anchors) AS latest_implied_start
FROM race
JOIN main.results AS re ON re.raceId = race.raceId
JOIN laps AS l ON l.raceId = re.raceId AND l.driverId = re.driverId AND l.lap = re.laps
WHERE re.position = 1;
